This is the gated wrap of viola adopt. Adopt takes a plain claude session by its session-shaped id and resumes it under viola with a name and parent the operator gives. A live-elsewhere refusal guards it.
The session changed no code, test, script, manifest, plugin, schema, dependency or spec text. It measured, and it recorded the outcome in the route's own records.
Measured: the live reading R5 went green. R5a adopted one real plain session the operator had ended and drove one turn that ended. R5b refused a live session with session-live and started nothing.
The ledger entry for adopt flips to complete on that reading. The two earlier R5a reds are recorded as readings that came before the green one.
The operator's relayed answers make adopt's provisional choices standing as his: never adopt a live session, refuse with a hint; a strict id form, CLI only; adopt's start like any start; and acceptance of both time-bound rows. The T-rows and both P5 answers stay provisional.
The final head's CI ran green with 7 of 7 checks. No gate, threshold, count or bound moved.

The time-bound rows under cognitive accessibility, Time bounds never fall on the human and Time bounds fall on the driver only, are provisional. The operator's relayed answer accepts both. Changing their state is a matter for the overseer's answer card, not this reconcile, so a picker should flag them only to say the operator's word now stands behind them.

The rule that live readings never gate. R5 is a live reading. Here it clears a route ledger entry by hand, under the operator's word. It does not gate the build or CI, and the a11y fail-fast gate stays on nextest and CI alone.

The refusal rules: Every refusal ends with a hint, the unable/hint pair, and reason codes beside unable. They rule over adopt's session-live refusal. The operator ratified that refusal as never adopt and refuse with a hint, and it read green live as refused=session-live with nothing started.

The revive --json session-live refusal contract and the start-against-a-holder refusals share adopt's session-live refusal word. They are touched only as rows sharing that word. Adopt's own refusal contract lives outside a11y-plan.

The rows that govern start refusals and start's --json refusal document now hold for adopt's start too, on the operator's word that adopt starts like any start. The a11y-plan rows naming adopt's start on the code's word stay as written.

The live reading ran with the compositor reporting locked. The R5 script hosts adopt in its own pseudo-terminal and opens no window. It reads no compositor bound and moves none, including the 5 s compositor read deadline and the 5 s window-step wait.
CI integration and the SLO and a11y budget rows. The gates ran green with no skips or retries, and no suite, driver, artifact or threshold changed.
Visual design and colour rows: SGR placement, amber, bold, dim, NAME truncation and colour inputs. No output surface changed.
The TUI passthrough contracts and the keyboard harness rows on human keystrokes, the wheel and zero viola bytes on the terminal. No passthrough behaviour changed.
Screen-reader targets and setups, and the manual Orca and keyboard passes. None was run or changed.
Exit-code contracts, fault bodies, instance-unreachable details, MCP tool contracts, and the list board, help, link, verify and wait output contracts. No code word, exit code or line changed.
The absences: no web or graphical frontend, no touch surface, no rendered page, no i18n, and no time limit on the user. None of these is changed.

It took the live reading R5 for viola adopt once on the operator's word. R5a: a real plain claude session that the operator started, typed one exchange into and ended himself was adopted by its id under a new name, with a parent and the launch pair haiku / low. The resume ran from a folder the session was not made in, one driven turn ended and the wrapper ended. All of it read green.
R5b stands from its earlier green firing: a session that a live claude holds was refused session-live and nothing was started. Two earlier R5a reds stand on record, each on a session with no kept transcript behind it.
The ledger row v2-13 (viola adopt) flips to complete on R5. The final CI ran green 7 of 7.
The wrap sets this chunk's PROVISIONAL rows standing as the operator's own answers. These are W1 (adopt refuses a live session, with a hint), W2 + W3 (strict session-id form, CLI only), W5 arm a (adopt's start strips and records like any start) and W4. The T-rows and both P5 answers stay PROVISIONAL.

body_fields.name: Gated live reading R5 needs no unlocked desktop
body_fields.rule: The gated live reading R5 of viola adopt is valid with the screen locked: its script hosts adopt in a pseudo-terminal of its own and opens no window, so an unlocked desktop is no precondition of the reading.
body_fields.why: The script types into its own pseudo-terminal and opens no window.
body_fields.because: The chunk's green R5a firing ran with the screen read locked, against the block's word «unlocked», and the report states the script needs no window, so future R5 firings must not wait on an unlocked desktop.

body_fields.name: R5a re-fires only on a fresh instance and base
body_fields.rule: Before any re-fire of the gated live reading R5a, the earlier firing's instance and base are moved aside whole; a re-fire on a reused instance is no reading.
body_fields.why: The R5a script reads the first session-start in the adopted instance's events, so an earlier firing's line would be read in place of the new one.
body_fields.because: The report records that the earlier firings' instance and base were moved aside because the script reads the first session-start, a precondition every later R5a firing must respect.

body_fields.name: R5a adopts only a session with a kept transcript
body_fields.rule: The gated live reading R5a adopts only a plain session whose transcript the CLI's store holds, one the operator started, made one exchange in and ended himself; a red reading on a session id with no kept transcript behind it proves nothing about adopt.
body_fields.why: Both earlier red R5a readings resumed session ids with no kept transcript behind them, while the green one resumed a session whose transcript the store holds.
body_fields.because: The report shows the two earlier reds on ids with no kept transcript and the green on an operator-made session the store holds, which binds what a valid R5a firing adopts.

This session is the gated part of the viola adopt chunk: it changed no source, test, script, manifest or plugin file.
It fired the gated live reading R5a once, on the operator's word: a real plain claude session he started, made one exchange in and ended himself, adopted by id under a given name with a parent and the haiku / low pair, one driven turn ended, the wrapper ended; it read green, resumed from a folder the session was not made in.
R5b (a real live session refused session-live with nothing started) was not re-fired; its earlier green line stands, so the ledger row v2-13 (viola adopt) flips verified on R5.
Two earlier R5a readings were red (no kept transcript behind the session id, the child exiting before any SessionStart) and stay recorded as readings, each final for its own firing; an overseer measurement firing was green but is no gated reading.
The green firing ran with the screen locked although the reading's premise named unlocked: the R5 script hosts adopt in its own pseudo-terminal and opens no window.
The operator's answers set this chunk's provisional rows on the live-session refusal, the closed session-id shape, the start-like launch pair and the time bounds standing as his; those rows sit in other masters.

The decision that real adopt is proven only by the gated live reading R5: R5a read green through the gated door and R5b's green stands, so what the row says is what happened; check its cell for any pending, unread or blocked wording.

The rule that a live failing reading is recorded as read, never as verification: the two red R5a readings and the overseer's green measurement firing stay as readings, only the gated green firing verifies.

The rules that the real claude CLI is tested local-only and never in CI, and that a fake-agent run is no proof of real-CLI behaviour: R5 is the local real-CLI reading for adopt, fired by the operator outside CI.

The rule of no human-in-loop verification and no manual smoke step: R5a needs a plain session the operator starts and ends by hand before the scripted reading fires; a row that bars any human step in a verification may need its exception for gated live readings.

The rule that tests never read the host's claude sessions: the R5 live reading resumes a real session from the host CLI's projects store by its id; a row may need to say gated live readings are outside it.

The live rig rows (one standing committed live rig, rig runs clean of the firing session, rig root outside every repository): the R5 adopt script is a second live reading, run from a scratch base outside the repository.
The sibling rows that window raise, window placement and fleet re-open are proven only by their gated live readings: adopt's R5 now stands with them as read green.

The session-live refusal rows (revive refusal code session-live, revive exit 1 session-live, session-live reading fails open): R5b's live refusal of a running session by adopt carries the same word and its green line stands.

The decision that the agent identity and claude child environment are stripped and the process-start claude-child record: adopt's start was ratified as a start like any other, with the same strip, by the operator's answer.

The rows on the time bounds that never fall on the human and fall on the driver, in the plan's other masters: the operator accepted both, but their rows stay outside this reconcile; flag only a test-plan row that repeats them.

body_fields.fact: The gated live reading R5 for viola adopt hosts adopt in its own pseudo-terminal and opens no window, so it is valid with the screen locked; it needs no unlocked desktop.
R5a reads the first session-start in the adopted instance's events, so before any re-fire the earlier firing's instance and base are moved aside whole; a re-fire on a reused instance is no reading.

R5a adopts only a session whose transcript the CLI's store holds, one the operator started, made one exchange in and ended himself; a session id with no kept transcript behind it gives a red reading that proves nothing about adopt.

body: The harness contract, agent-run commands, boot, cleanup, status, supervisor and session record rows: no harness surface moved.
CI integration, quality gates, coverage floors, performance budgets, mutation gates and the pre-push gate: they ran green with no threshold, floor or bound moved.
Fake agent command line, receipts, scripts, recorded fixtures and fixture hygiene: no fixture or fake-agent option was added or changed.
MCP tools, wrapper channel, JSON-RPC errors, send, answer, wait, release and list contracts: adopt added none and this session changed none.
Log format, log event corr, process log line and secret-scan contracts: no log field or scan class moved.
Mocking discipline, test anti-patterns and supply-chain rows: no dependency, crate or test helper changed.
